definitions.explanation: The measurement from the crotch to the bottom of the leg, used primarily when buying or tailoring pants. Also refers to the corresponding part of a garment.

examples.japanese: {股下|またした}のサイズを{測|はか}った。
このズボンは{股下|またした}が{長|なが}すぎる。
examples.english: These pants are too long in the inseam.

examples.japanese: ネットで{注文|ちゅうもん}するときは{股下|またした}の{長|なが}さを{確認|かくにん}してから{買|か}うとよい。
examples.english: When ordering online, it's good to check the inseam length before buying.

notes:
{股下|またした} is essential vocabulary for clothes shopping in Japan, especially for pants. Japanese sizes often list {股下|またした} separately, and alterations ({裾上|すそあ}げ) are commonly done at purchase.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {股下|またした}の{長|なが}さ — inseam length
- {股下|またした}○○センチ — inseam of XX centimeters
- {股下|またした}を{測|はか}る — to measure the inseam

RELATED WORDS:
- {股上|またがみ} — rise (crotch to waistband)
- {裾上|すそあ}げ — hemming (pants)
- ウエスト — waist
